findings.description: Expense titles are stored and rendered as raw HTML. An editor saved the title , and the list shows it unescaped, so the script runs for any viewer who opens /expenses (stored XSS).
repro: Open /expenses/new, enter title , category travel, amount 1, and save
Sign in as viewer-eb09 and open /expenses
Observe the alert dialog fire; the title cell contains an unescaped img element

notes: Tested: viewer list total and filter by category (all correct); viewer blocked from /expenses/new, /expenses/1/edit, POST /expenses, POST /expenses/1 and POST /expenses/1/delete (all 403); editor add (success message, one new row, persists after reload, total correct); editor edit (flash, list and total updated, persists); server-side validation rejects negative amount, bad category and blank title (400). Side effects on shared data: added 'QA Test Taxi' ($10.25), added a row with the XSS title ($1.00, id 10), and changed 'Client taxi' from $18.75 to $30.00. The brief's 'Add expense' label is rendered as 'New expense' on the page; not reported as a bug since the wording is a paraphrase and the function works.
